the u.s. embassy in kuwait has completed its analysis of the proposals submitted in response to the above-referenced solicitation. following a thorough evaluation, the renovation of two (2) bathrooms and one (1) kitchen at sdh project has been awarded under contract no. 19ku2025c0012 to advanced future group international gen. trading & cont. for a total amount of 13,620.000 kwd (approximately $44,455.928 usd ). a notice of contract award has been published on sam.gov and is available for public reference. we sincerely thank you for your interest in this solicitation and for the time and effort invested in your proposal.

the u.s. embassy in kuwait has just released and posted amendment the purpose of this amendment 0002 is to: post questions and answers; and attachment a – statement of work is hereby deleted in its entirety and replaced with the revised attachment a – statement of work, attached to this amendment.. the revised attachment a incorporates applicable technical clarifications and revisions resulting from the government’s responses to offeror questions, including, but not limited to, clarifications concerning room dimensions, drywall and moisture-resistant material requirements, tile and waterproofing requirements, counters and sinks, plumbing and drainage, shower and hand-sprayer requirements, aba/ada requirements, material and product submittals, project documentation, safety plans, warranty requirements, and other technical requirements addressed in the questions and answers. offerors shall prepare their quotations based on the solicitation as amended, including the revised attachment a. kindly visit to www.sam.gov , click on the “search” option, select “contract opportunities” from available domains, enter “ 19ku2026q0012 ” in the white area and click on “search submit your quote electronically by email to kuwait_solicitation@state.gov. quotations are due by august 20, 2026, at 10:00 am kuwait local time. no quotes will be accepted after this time. please enter the title of your email as “ quote – rfq _19ku2026q0012 – chancery annex restroom, lactation rm &locker rms renovation.
